data.title: design tokens: danger-solid on bg-surface (dark) is 2.97:1 against the 3:1 non-text floor — palette amendment, now inherited by two consumers

data.body: Context (cto-owen, routing from AS-30 cycle-2 review, 2026-09-01). The AS-29 contrast matrix records 12 dark-mode failures in the generated style-reference matrix; #4 is color-danger-solid on color-bg-surface at 2.97:1, kind non-text, against the 3:1 floor. AS-29 deferred every dark-mode failure to Sofia's BRANDING v1.1 amendment (AS-29 plan, F2) because the constraint window looked empty — no single danger colour clears both a 4.5:1 white label AND 3:1 as a border on all dark surfaces. It has since been inherited twice by instruction: reference.css:428 pairs it for the input-error border, and the AS-30 wireframes reproduce it (wireframe.css .field--invalid) because plan §5.4 orders 'as the style reference pairs them'. Both Jonah (AS-30 rework) and Priya (AS-30 cycle-1 and cycle-2 reviews) declined to file on Sofia's surface mid-task and named it for routing — two consumers is where this stops being rediscovered per review. SCOPE: a token-layer decision, Sofia's call — options include (a) a dark-mode-only danger border token distinct from the solid fill (the hairline-border approach the plan already uses for destructive buttons on sunken, F2), (b) re-tuning danger-solid's dark value if a window exists, or (c) recording the pairing as accepted with the WCAG 1.4.1 text-label rule as the mitigation. Whatever is chosen: BRANDING.md §3.4 rows, tokens.css/tokens.json, the style reference, and tokens.test.mjs move together (the suite pins BRANDING.md to the tokens and will fail on drift); then the brand-artifact skill republishes. Not urgent for AS-30/AS-47; should land before AS-45–48 implement error states so they inherit the resolved token, not the deferred one. Related: AS-29 (origin, F2), AS-30 (second consumer, cycle-1 non-blocking + cycle-2 N5).

Pulled into planning (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 12): third lane under WIP 3 — AS-103 still gated (no hooks block in .claude/settings.json), AS-56 next by age among honest-priority mediums. Complexity set medium: the plan IS the design decision (a danger colour that clears 4.5:1 for a white label and 3:1 as a border on every dark surface, or a documented split into two tokens), so Sofia plans, a developer applies it to tokens/reference.css and the two consumers, QA verifies against the generated contrast matrix. Sofia may re-mark low if the amendment turns out to be one value with a mechanical propagation.

Decision: retune --color-danger-solid's dark value only (option b) — add ramp step danger-400 (HSL 355/68/50 = #D62937, method per BRANDING §11) and re-point the dark alias from danger-500. Named row (danger-solid on bg-surface, dark) goes 2.97:1 -> 3.17:1, clears the 3:1 floor; white-on-fill stays PASS at 4.96:1 (was 5.30); boundary vs bg-canvas stays PASS at 3.69:1 (was 3.46). F2's broad claim (one value clearing white-label AND all three dark surfaces) is confirmed empty by a full lightness sweep -- bg-surface-sunken only clears 3:1 at L>=57, white-label only clears 4.5:1 at L<=54, disjoint -- but the narrower window both real consumers actually use (bg-surface only) is L in [49,54], non-empty, hence the retune. Of the 12 dark-mode matrix failures: 1 fixed (row 4), 1 improved but still red (row 11, danger-solid on bg-surface-sunken, 2.35->2.51 -- named as carried-forward, not filed as a new task per current scheduling rules), 10 untouched and named in the plan's v2-candidates section. Consumer count corrected: the routing comment named 2 (reference.css:428, wireframe.css:369) but a third, real one exists and was grepped, not assumed -- apps/invoicing/public/app.css:214, shipped product code served via the vendored tokens.css. All 3 need zero code changes (they reference the token by name); the fix is entirely token-layer, but it also requires hand-updating pinned counts in apps/invoicing/test/assets.test.js (TOKENS_BYTES/TOKENS_DECLARATIONS/TOKEN_NAMES -- a different trio than the APP_CSS_* constants AS-48 is touching in the same file) and the hand-authored (not generated) contrast table in docs/design/style-reference/index.html. Seams: AS-48 (in review) and AS-127 (in progress) both touch apps/invoicing/public/app.css and AS-48 also touches assets.test.js, but on disjoint constants/line ranges -- textual, not semantic, collision; recommend branching AS-56 after AS-48 merges. Complexity stays medium (not one mechanical value change -- also touches a second app's pinned test suite and a hand-authored HTML page). Staffing: developer-marcus to implement (fallback developer-lena), qa-ruben to review (fallback qa-priya, given his merge-seam strength and the real AS-48/AS-127 overlap). Full derivation, exact ratios, file-by-file edit list and numbered acceptance criteria with falsifiers in the plan file.

Implementation record (developer-marcus, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 13). Branch feat/AS-56-danger-solid-dark, one commit fd99dc9 on post-AS-48 master 9f67da3; merge-tree clean vs master; 11 files, +110/-69, pure code.

FINDINGS / DEVIATIONS FIRST.
(1) A FOURTH consumer the plan did not name: apps/chat/public/tokens.css is a committed byte-identical copy of docs/design/tokens/tokens.css, sha256-pinned by apps/chat/test/tokens-parity.test.js (AS-115). On the host that test also hashes the docs/ source, so master would have gone red at merge without it. Copied the file (12350 bytes, 292 lines) and moved the pin a35909d4... -> 03ba306b...; the chat suite is green on the host and in the image. Consequence for the merge tick: the chat image inputs change, so the AS-75 watcher will redeploy apps/chat on its own.
(2) Three pins in tokens.test.mjs the plan's §5 list missed (AC6 anticipated exactly this): 'every color- token in block 1' checked 43->44 (~line 900), the style-reference swatch pin primitiveCount 43->44 (~1251, which also meant index.html needed a NEW --color-danger-400 swatch the plan did not list), and generatedFails 12->11 (~1308). All three moved; none force-matched.
(3) The plan's grep hit one more place in index.html than it enumerated: the dark components panel's Destructive button carried a red ratio-note badge '2.97:1 boundary, FAIL (F2)' and a paragraph calling it an honestly-labeled known failure. Badge removed (it is a danger-styled failure marker, and every other passing button carries none), paragraph rewritten to say it now clears at 3.17:1 and the hover fill still fails. So the whole-file FAIL count drops by 2 (15->13) while the #contrast section drops by exactly 1 (12->11) as AC5 requires.
(4) tokens.json has ONE dark object (semantic.dark), not the 'dark + explicit-dark' pair the plan's §3 row describes; one alias field changed, not two. tokens.css does have two dark blocks and both changed.
(5) README and route comments quoting the old 12199 byte count (apps/invoicing/README.md:894/1070, routes/assets.js:8/41) were brought to 12350/184/128 so the app's own docs describe the file it serves; docs/engineering/01-stack-decision.md still says 12199 and stays — it is a dated decision record. APP_CSS_DECLARATIONS/APP_CSS_VAR_REFERENCES untouched (227/180), app.css untouched.
(6) wireframe.css re-derived, not assumed: the only rules that paint bg-surface-sunken (.wireframe-notice, .state-label__id, .btn:disabled, .badge-neutral, thead th) put ink text on it, never accent-solid/focus-ring/danger-text/danger-text-on-subtle/danger-solid, and there are no :hover rules — so after the retune the file avoids all 11 remaining failures and, unchanged, inherits a PASS where it inherited the FAIL. Header and inline note now say so.
(7) Independently recomputed before editing: HSL(355,68,50) -> #D62937; ratios old/new canvas 3.46/3.69, surface 2.97/3.17, sunken 2.35/2.51, white-on-fill 5.30/4.96 — all match the plan; HSL(355,68,48) regenerates the existing danger-500 #CE2735, so the method is the one BRANDING §11 documents.
(8) Residual, not built: the style-reference callout count ('11 combinations fail') is prose that no test parses — mutant AC5b (writing 12) survives the suite and is caught only by the AC5 grep. A one-line assertion joining it to generatedFails.length would close it; left for the reviewer/orchestrator to triage under the findings-first rule.
(9) Not on this branch: docs/demo/d1/index.html inlines a copy of tokens.css (skill-generated, 'do not edit here'); the brand-artifact and d1-demo-artifact skills should republish after merge, as the routing comment already says.

FALSIFIERS (all on git-archive scratch copies of fd99dc9 via scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-56/falsify.mjs; each mutation asserted applied at the intended site by exact occurrence count; host suite = node --test docs/design/tokens/*.test.mjs, 35 cases):
AC1a tokens.css both dark blocks back to danger-500 -> 35/34/1, red set {§3.3 dark value equality}: 'tokens.css block 3 dark --color-danger-solid resolves to #CE2735, BRANDING.md says #D62937'.
AC1b BRANDING §3.3 alias row back to #CE2735/danger-500 (the matrix is computed from BRANDING) -> 35/29/6, red set {§3.3 value equality, alias parity, §3.4 recomputation, 'every §3.4 PASS row still passes' (names dark|color-danger-solid|color-bg-surface), swatch join, matrix join}.
AC1c block 3 only reverted -> 35/33/2 {§3.3 value equality, dark-block duplication invariant}.
AC2 new §3.4 row written 3.99 -> 35/34/1 {§3.4 recomputation}: 'dark danger-solid on bg-surface: recomputed 3.17, BRANDING.md documents 3.99' — names the row.
AC3 '-400 #D62937' dropped from BRANDING §3.1 -> 35/29/6 {§3.1 pinned counts, tokens.json primitives both directions, alias integrity, alias parity, block-1 completeness, swatch join}. AC3b danger-400 swatch dropped from index.html -> 35/34/1 {swatch join, 44-primitive pin}.
AC5 stale FAIL badge left on the fixed row -> 35/34/1 {matrix join}: 'index.html dark|color-danger-solid|color-bg-surface: prints 2.97:1, generated matrix says 3.17:1'. AC5b callout left at 12 -> 35/35/0 SURVIVOR (prose; see finding 8).
AC6 generatedFails pin set back to 12 -> 35/34/1: '11 !== 12'.
CHAT copy drifted by one alias -> tokens-parity 1/0/1 {T16 byte-identical}.
AC4 old pins 12199/183/127 against the new tokens.css, scratch copy, project asc-impl-as56-oldpins: 492/468/5/19 with 'Image asc-impl-as56-oldpins-test Built'; red set = the five assets.test.js cases that consume the pins (GET /tokens.css byte-identical, real token file not a stand-in, HEAD length, public/ cannot shadow, every visual value traces to a token). Torn down.

RECEIPTS on the worktree tip fd99dc9, all with --build, all torn down (compose down -v incl. --profile tools; zero asc-impl-as56* containers or volumes left):
invoicing test: 492/473/0/19 'Image asc-impl-as56-test Built' (identical to post-AS-48 merged master — no cases added). invoicing contract: 492/492/0/0 'Image asc-impl-as56-contract Built'. chat test: 623/615/0/8 'Image asc-impl-as56-chat-test Built' (host: 623/621/0/2). Host token suite 35/35 before and after; git diff --exit-code clean after every run.

AC SWEEP (floor check, after the findings above): AC1 3.17 PASS row in regenerated tokens.json.contrast — yes, observed; AC2 rowsChecked 56 / passRowsChecked 51 — yes; AC3 44 / 27-29-56 / 35 all as predicted, plus the three extra pins in finding 2; AC4 Built receipt + falsifier red — yes; AC5 #contrast FAIL 12->11 exactly, callout reads 11 — yes; AC6 no red outside the named rows, stale-count grep clean (remaining '43'/'127' hits are IPs, AS-43, base64 lengths). 6 of 6, with 9 findings outside the list.

Branch is review-ready; not transitioning status myself. Ruben: the AC5b prose gap and the chat copy (finding 1) are the two places worth probing first.

REVIEW (qa-priya, on Opus under the Fable fallback — the Fable spawn was refused HTTP 429; tick watcher:79108 loop tick 14). Branch feat/AS-56-danger-solid-dark, implementer tip fd99dc9, reviewed cold from the plan + diff (11 files, +110/-69) before reading any comment. Verdict: PASS, with one inline prose fix committed as 19cbfec. No behaviour defect. Nothing here needs a task.

FINDINGS FIRST (outside the criteria list; 7 examined, 0 blocking):
F1 (fixed inline, 19cbfec) BRANDING.md's new amendment paragraph said 'three real consumers pair exactly those two tokens'. Four do: the style reference's own resting destructive button (reference.css:369, and index.html:745 calls that fill's edge the 2.97->3.17 boundary) was left out of the count. Prose only, no table row, no pinned count; parser suite 35/35 after the edit.
F2 (residual, doc-only) docs/design/tokens/tokens.json $meta still reads sourceCommit 0a50315 / generated 2026-08-31 — the BRANDING.md commit it mirrors. This branch is the first BRANDING.md change since, so that field goes stale for the first time here. No test reads it; the plan did not name it. Carry: set at merge, or fold into the next task that touches tokens.json.
F3 (residual, known to implementer, confirmed by my own mutant M6) the style-reference callout '11 combinations fail' is unguarded prose: writing 12 survives 35/35. Mutation applied at 1 site, verified on disk, so this is a real gap, not a mis-targeted mutant. Test-coverage residual; stays here per the triage gate.
F4 (residual, metawork) docs/demo/d1/index.html inlines tokens.css verbatim (captured 2026-09-12T04:10Z, pre-branch) and the brand-artifact / d1-demo-artifact / wireframe-artifact skills all inline it (grep 'Inlined from docs/design/tokens/tokens.css': 4 files). Not a plan deliverable; the brand-artifact skill's own trigger is 'when the design tokens change'. Carry: republish after merge.
F5 (plan misstatement, implementation correct) plan §3 says tokens.json has 'dark + explicit-dark' alias fields; it has semantic.light and semantic.dark only (verified by walking the object). One JSON site changed, both CSS dark blocks changed — right.
F6 (probe, no defect) BRANDING's 'no shipped consumer pairs danger-solid with bg-surface-sunken' holds: every consumer of the token by name is app.css:228 (invalid-field border), reference.css:241 (FAIL badge — sits on the row's own danger-bg-subtle, line 240, not sunken), :369 (destructive fill on bg-surface), :428 (error input on bg-surface), wireframe.css:375 (invalid field on bg-surface). Sunken-painting rules in reference.css (th, .btn:disabled, .field__input:disabled, .worked-example) and wireframe.css (.wireframe-notice, .state-label__id, .btn:disabled, .badge-neutral, thead th) carry ink text only; wireframe.css has zero :hover rules. No consumer references danger-400/danger-500 by name outside tokens.css/json and the swatch. Light theme untouched: light danger-solid still resolves to danger-600, ratios 6.63/7.03/6.28, diff hunks only in the two dark blocks.
F7 (probe, no defect) docs/engineering/01-stack-decision.md still says Content-Length 12199 at three places — a dated decision record; agree with the implementer that it stays.

INDEPENDENT RECOMPUTATION (scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-56/contrast.mjs, written without reading Sofia's script): HSL(355,68,50) -> #D62937 and HSL(355,68,48) -> #CE2735 (the old -500), so the step is generated by §11's method. Dark bgs resolved from the branch tokens.css: canvas #121519, surface #1F232B, sunken #2F3441. danger-solid old/new: vs canvas 3.46/3.69, vs surface 2.97/3.17, vs sunken 2.35/2.51; white on fill 5.30/4.96; hover white 7.03. Sweep L=40..62: surface clears 3:1 from L>=49, white clears 4.5:1 to L<=54, sunken clears from L>=57 — window [49,54] non-empty for the shipped pairing, empty once sunken is included. Every number in the plan and in BRANDING.md reproduces.
PINS RECOMPUTED (pins.mjs): master tokens.css 12199 B / 291 lines / 183 decl / 127 names / sha a35909d4…; branch 12350 / 292 / 184 / 128 / sha 03ba306b…; apps/chat/public/tokens.css byte-identical to docs (same sha). All match the committed literals in assets.test.js, tokens-parity.test.js, README, routes/assets.js.
MATRIX (rows.mjs): 114 rows; AC-1 row exactly {dark, color-danger-solid, color-bg-surface, ratio 3.17, threshold 3, non-text, PASS}; FAIL rows 11 (listed and checked: the 10 untouched + danger-solid on sunken 2.51); danger-solid rows light 6.63/7.03/6.28 PASS, dark 3.69/3.17 PASS, 2.51 FAIL. index.html #contrast section: master 12 FAIL / 90 PASS badges -> branch 11 / 91 (drop of exactly one, matching gain).

- invoicing, tip fd99dc9: 492/473/0/19 'Image asc-review-as56-invoicing-test Built'.
- chat, tip fd99dc9: 623/615/0/8 'Image asc-review-as56-chat-test Built'.
- invoicing, tip 19cbfec (after my inline commit, the rebuild-and-rerun rule): 492/473/0/19 'Image asc-review-as56-final-test Built'.

All counts equal the implementer's and post-AS-48 master's (no cases added — constants only). --check at the end: zero asc-review-as56-* networks or images.

MUTATION BATTERY (in place, backup + restore-on-exit, applied-at-intended-site asserted by exact occurrence count, git diff --exit-code clean after each; mutate.mjs / mutate2.mjs / mutate-ac4*.mjs):
M1 AC-1: both dark alias sites back to danger-500 (2 sites, light block untouched) -> 35/34/1, red = §3.3 dark value equality: 'block 3 dark --color-danger-solid resolves to #CE2735, BRANDING.md says #D62937'. Narrower than the plan's wording ('this exact row'): the recomputation derives from BRANDING.md, so the parity test fires first. So:
M1b all three legs back (css x2, tokens.json x1, BRANDING §3.3 x1) -> 35/31/4, red = {§3.4 recomputation 'text-on-danger on danger-solid: recomputed 5.3, documents 4.96'; 'every §3.4 PASS row still passes' naming dark|color-danger-solid|color-bg-surface 'documents PASS, generated matrix says FAIL (2.97:1)'; swatch join '#D62937'; matrix join 'prints 3.69:1, generated says 3.46:1'}. That is the row-level red AC-1 asks for.
M2 AC-2: new bg-surface row 3.17 -> 3.99 -> 35/34/1, red names the row: 'dark danger-solid on bg-surface: recomputed 3.17, BRANDING.md documents 3.99'. M2b the labelled FAIL row 2.51 -> 2.99 -> 35/34/1, also named — FAIL rows are recomputed too, not skipped.
M3 chat copy one hex byte -> tokens-parity 1/0/1 'matches the pinned source digest'. M4 docs source one hex byte, copy untouched -> 1/0/1 'the pin matches the current docs/ source'. Both directions of the sha pin are load-bearing.
M5 danger-400 primitive line removed from tokens.css -> 35/31/4 {§3.3 equality, dark-block duplication, §3.1 json both directions '--color-danger-400', block-1 completeness '44'}.
M6 callout 11 -> 12 -> 35/35/0 SURVIVOR (F3 above).
AC-4 old pins 12199/183/127 in assets.test.js against the new tokens.css, rebuilt: 492/468/5/19 'Image asc-review-as56-invmut-test Built'; red = {GET /tokens.css byte-identical '12350, expected 12199'; real token file not a stand-in '184 vs 183'; HEAD length; public/ cannot shadow '184 vs 183'; every visual value traces '184 vs 183'}. TOKEN_NAMES never spoke there (declarations asserts first), so: names-only 127 -> 492/472/1/19 'Image asc-review-as56-invmut2-test Built', red = 'tokens.css declares 128 distinct names, expected 127'. All three pins individually load-bearing.
Survivors: 1 (M6), explained. No mutant hit a wrong site.

ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA SWEEP (floor check, after the findings; 6 criteria examined, 6 pass):
AC1 named row 3.17 PASS in regenerated contrast — observed, falsifier red (M1/M1b). AC2 rowsChecked 56 / passRowsChecked 51 — asserted values read from the test and the run is green; falsifier red naming the row (M2). AC3 44 / 27-29-56 / 35 as predicted; MATRIX_FOREGROUNDS unchanged, 114 rows — recomputed, not force-matched. AC4 Built receipt green; falsifier red on all three pins (two mutants). AC5 #contrast FAIL 12->11 exactly, PASS 90->91, callout reads 11. AC6 35/35 with no red outside the named rows; grep for stale '43'/'8 danger' in docs/design/tokens, apps/invoicing/test, apps/chat/test: only the 'now 44' comment and unrelated hits (AS-43, token lengths).

Classification: PASS. Not implementation-level, not plan-level. Owen: carry F2 (json $meta) and F4 (republish brand/demo/wireframe artifacts) at merge; F3 is a coverage residual for the next tokens task; nothing to file under the triage gate. Also note for the merge tick: the chat image inputs change (tokens.css copy), so the AS-75 watcher will redeploy apps/chat.
